f7_d4_total_A.hint: A in bulk is 8000(1 − x_b), A on the boundaries is 200(1 − θ); add them.

f7_d4_excess_equal.hint: Compare the cell's B count with the 8200-site reference when θ and x_b are equal.

f7_d4_excess_008.hint: Count boundary B, bulk B and reference B, then divide the difference by both boundaries' area (40 nm²).

f7_d4_mol_m2_025.hint: Multiply by 1e18 nm² per m², then divide by N_Av atoms per mol.

f7_d5_odds.hint: Bulk odds x_b/(1 − x_b) times the supplied factor 1.82459687.

f7_d5_theta.hint: From odds r, θ = r/(1 + r).

f7_d5_boundary_B.hint: θ is a fraction of 200 boundary sites (both boundaries), so the count is 200θ.

f7_d5_excess.hint: Use 5(θ − x_b) atom/nm²: 100 sites per 20 nm² of one boundary.

f7_d5_mol_m2.hint: Take the atom/nm² value, multiply by 1e18 and divide by N_Av.

f7_d5_theta_delta0.hint: With δ = 0 the factor exp(−δ/RT) is one.

f7_d6_total_A.hint: Every site holds A or B: 8200 minus total B.

f7_d6_boundary_B_035.hint: 200 boundary sites times the trial θ.

f7_d6_bulk_B_035.hint: Total B stays fixed; subtract what sits on the boundaries.

f7_d6_x_b_035.hint: Bulk B divided by 8000 bulk sites.

f7_d6_wrong_B_035.hint: 8000 × 0.10 in bulk plus the trial boundary B; compare with the fixed total.

f7_d6_theta_round1.hint: Round 1 uses x_b = x0 in the odds formula, exactly as in the open cell.

f7_d6_x_b_round1.hint: Subtract 200θ from the fixed total B, then divide by 8000.

f7_d6_theta_final.hint: Repeat: odds formula at the current x_b, then update x_b from the fixed 850 B; four or five rounds are enough.

f7_d6_x_b_final.hint: Use x_b = (850 − 200θ)/8000 with the settled θ.

f7_d6_boundary_B_final.hint: 200 boundary sites times the settled θ; bulk B plus boundary B must still be 850.

f7_d9_odds.hint: Bulk odds 0.20/0.80 times the supplied factor.

f7_d9_theta.hint: From odds r, θ = r/(1 + r).

f7_d9_excess.hint: 5(θ − x_b) atom/nm² with the new reservoir x_b.

f7_d9_excess_count.hint: Excess atom/nm² times 40 nm², or 200(θ − x_b); both routes must agree.

f7_d9_total_B.hint: 8000 x0 + 200 θ0 with the new starting values.

f7_d9_boundary_B.hint: 200 boundary sites times the trial θ.

f7_d9_bulk_B.hint: Subtract the boundary B from this cell's fixed total B.

f7_d9_x_b.hint: Bulk B divided by 8000 bulk sites.

f7_d9_wrong_B.hint: 8000 × 0.20 in bulk plus the trial boundary B; compare with the fixed total.

f7_baseline_eta.hint: Only the 200 boundary sites carry the 2000 J/mol; spread that over all 8200 sites.
